methodology.hypothesis: A permanently held gold defense may fail in some regimes. Compare an unchanged four-factor equity core with defensive selection across gold,long-duration Treasuries,intermediate Treasuries and actual bills.
methodology.equity: Each equity factor retains25%of the equity sleeve. Balance this aggregate sleeve and the selected defensive sleeve using trailing63-session volatility; constrain the equity share to30%-70%of98%invested capital.
methodology.defensive_selection: At completed month ends, retain defensive funds whose126-session adjusted return strictly exceeds BIL over the same interval. One method selects the highest return, ticker as tie-breaker. The other inverse-volatility weights all eligible defensive funds.
methodology.cash_state: If none qualify, defensive allocation is BIL and the equity sleeve is fixed at its30%minimum; do not divide by near-zero bill volatility or invent interest.
methodology.data: Use the previously verified original factor-fund and benchmark snapshots. TLT comes from the exact same already-audited base manifest, with no new adjusted-price vintage or fabricated history.
methodology.timing: Only completed month-end information; next-session-open base or one-extra-session stressed execution. Original USD10,000,USD1commissions,5/20bp costs and all program Sharpe/SPY/15%drawdown gates remain unchanged.
methodology.risks: Treasury duration and gold can both lose money. Relative momentum and diversification do not guarantee any maximum drawdown.
methodology.interpretation: Two defensive-allocation hypotheses on four existing economic factor exposures, not two newly discovered independent factors. They are formed after94prior configurations; preserve all failures.
